execution_gate: Final source projection/registry/code hashes and fixture reviews must be sealed before measurement preparation. Expected-target metadata remains opaque until prediction artifacts are sealed.
scientific_question: Do the previously frozen Pharos PPI masks improve expected intervention-target recovery within an otherwise identical phosphosite-based RoKAI pipeline? This is downstream biological utility, not functional-PPI truth or global scientific accuracy.

algorithm.license: MIT; separate upstream notice retained. No GPL benchmark code copied.
algorithm.implementation: Unchanged author numeric core/circuit and mean/zscore readout; transport only around it.

common_inputs.KS_prior: Source-qualified canonical/no-explicit-state human direct SIGNOR phosphorylation, sequence-compatible, then exact parent-study block and unique gene-product-compatible source enzymes before binary dedup. This is an alternative prior, not author PSP replication.
common_inputs.source_citations: Require positive numeric PMID for retained prior records; preserve all unknown-source rows as excluded, not false. Exact study exclusion does not guarantee removal of untagged reused evidence.
common_inputs.enzyme_universe: All eligible source enzymes with >=1 retained KS site and unambiguous gene/canonical-product correspondence. No >=5 source-site cutoff. Same fixed universe in all arms.
common_inputs.sites: Union of retained KS sites and all strictly mapped supplied observation sites; retain observed sites without KS edges as isolated input nodes.
common_inputs.Wsite2site: Zero sparse matrix, supported ablation; no PSP/PTMcode data.
common_inputs.PPI: Only source-attested weighted historical pairs within eligible enzyme universe, using existing frozen memberships. All arms preserve exact original native conductances [0,1], including NE; no new threshold or score replacement.

reference.conditions: All122 native unique matrix headers,61 shared treatments in HL60 and MCF7. No outcome-based condition selection.
reference.units: Reported processed log2 fold changes supported by primary accepted manuscript; no extra log/normalization. Archive/original-TSV identity and upstream zero/multisite processing remain unresolved.
reference.known_preprocessing: Author split compound site assignments, selected minimum-p peptide per site, converted exact0 to missing. Atomic row does not prove an independent localized peptide. Preserve supplied finite0 if any; do not repeat zero removal.
reference.truth_scope: Author-assigned expected drug targets and inhibition direction, not directly measured native kinase activities; other kinases are not confirmed biological negatives.
reference.exposure_rule: Exclude exact exposed experiment IDs and known exposed parent studies; no dataset switch if coverage poor. Hijazi-specific paper/code has been read for methods, so do not call this completely blinded literature-independent confirmation.

mapping_and_missingness.measurement_ID: Exactly gene_site|gene|site, with internally consistent redundant first field and site fullmatch[STY][1-9][0-9]*. Treat middle field only as author-intended gene token; no lexical accession/ENSP fallback.
mapping_and_missingness.identity: Existing Registry resolver, unshadowed approved or unique HGNC-curated legacy relation; one reviewed-human unshared product; captured primary gene equals approved gene; exact current reference position/residue. No isoform/construct/allele equivalence.
mapping_and_missingness.duplicates: For mapped same protein/site/condition use a single distinct finite value only; different finite values are unresolved NaN. No arbitrary averaging or most-significant choice.
mapping_and_missingness.metadata_targets: Split source semicolon sets and trim delimiters only; normalize by same frozen HGNC rule; duplicate condition/resolved-gene/sign cases collapse with raw provenance. Unknown/ambiguous reference genes or conflicting signs are unscorable reference cases, not method negatives.
mapping_and_missingness.model_abstention: Valid reference gene lacking an unambiguous finite model target remains in the denominator at worst rank M; report reason/coverage. No silent unscored-target dropping.

scoring.primary: Signed target rank via scipy.stats.rankdata(negative_expected_signed_scores,method=average), divided by fixed candidate universe M. Missing/unscored model target gets rank M and normalizedrank1. Lower is better.
scoring.macro: Average qualified distinct expected targets per condition; require one qualified condition in each declared cell per drug; average the two cells per drug, then equally across drugs. Incomplete reference groups are reported separately. Model abstentions do not make a reference condition incomplete.
secondary: Same-macro per-target signed top5 recovery; unscored targets never hits.
Coverage and source/identity/reference exclusions, full case accounting.
Per-cell summaries and predeclared source-degree>=5 diagnostic, no subgroup winner selection.
scoring.uncertainty: Paired drug-level bootstrap10000 draws seed20261112; descriptive conditional interval, not independent study/population precision. No AUROC/AUPRC using other kinases as biological negatives.
scoring.benefit_interpretation: Only state a consistent conditional primary benefit if mean normalized rank improves over BOTH native and unpruned, top5 and expected-direction agreement do not worsen, and neither cell has worse mean rank. Report paired uncertainty and stronger NE control even if it wins. No later candidate promotion or new tuning.
